A user has filed a support ticket reporting that their experience
with the service has degraded — requests feel slow or are failing
for them. The on-call team needs you to investigate.

Telemetry parquets are stored in: `.`
Available files: abnormal_metrics.parquet, abnormal_traces.parquet,
abnormal_logs.parquet, abnormal_metrics_histogram.parquet,
abnormal_metrics_sum.parquet, normal_metrics.parquet,
normal_traces.parquet, normal_logs.parquet.

Walk the telemetry to identify which endpoints / services are
actually affected, then determine the root cause(s) of the
degradation.

content.text: I'll start by listing the tables and checking their schemas.
Next I'll compare per-service span counts, error shares and latency between the normal and abnormal periods.

content.text: The `contacts` endpoint on `ts-admin-basic-info-service` takes about 1720 ms in the abnormal period, against about 10 ms normally. The time sits inside the `getAllContacts` method itself. Next I'll check the child spans, the logs, and which services call this endpoint.

input.query: SELECT c.service_name, c.span_name, c.attr_span_kind, count(*) n, round(avg(c.duration)/1e6,1) ms, round(avg(p.duration)/1e6,1) parent_ms FROM abnormal_traces c JOIN abnormal_traces p ON c.parent_span_id = p.span_id AND c.trace_id=p.trace_id WHERE p.span_name LIKE '%getAllContacts%' OR p.span_name LIKE '%adminbasic/contacts%' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT service_name, level, attr_log_template, count(*) c FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level <> 'INFO' GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY c DESC

content.text: The `getAllContacts` method spends about 1.7 s in its own code. Its outgoing call to `ts-contacts-service` takes only about 5 ms, so the delay is inside the method. Logs also show ERROR entries in `ts-route-service`, `ts-travel2-service` and `ts-admin-route-service`, which I'll examine next.

input.query: SELECT service_name, level, left(message,160) msg, count(*) c FROM abnormal_logs WHERE level IN ('ERROR','WARN') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT service_name, level, left(message,160) msg, count(*) c FROM normal_logs WHERE level IN ('ERROR','WARN') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY c DESC

content.text: The route-not-found errors also appear in the normal period, so they are baseline noise rather than the fault. Next I'll check the infrastructure metrics for `ts-admin-basic-info-service` and whether `ts-ui-dashboard` is slow across all endpoints or only on the contacts path.

input.query: SELECT metric, service_name, round(avg(value) FILTER (WHERE 1=1),3) mean_any FROM abnormal_metrics WHERE service_name IN ('ts-admin-basic-info-service') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT span_name, count(*) c, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) ms, round(max(duration)/1e6,1) mx FROM abnormal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

content.text: The slowdown is confined to the `/adminbasic/contacts` path on the dashboard, and the other basic-info endpoints look normal. To rule out a second fault, I'll compare the dashboard's endpoints between the two periods.

input.query: SELECT span_name, count(*) c, round(avg(duration)/1e6,1) ms FROM normal_traces WHERE service_name='ts-ui-dashboard' AND attr_span_kind='Server' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
